feature_contract.goal: Prevent original directly submitted white HUD glyph matrices from borrowing a selected queued SpriteNode during reentrant and just-ended queue transitions in the R84 per-eye shader HUD route, while preserving correct direct and queued source projection.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only source-proven R84 shader ScreenHud original c64 provenance; preserve queued projected rank, GOAL/+TIME, stage, C993/CABE lens, F11, input, FFB, SkyGlow and R26_SAFE legacy rollback.
trace_stages: OutRun game draws direct HUD text and asynchronously selected queued SpriteNode HUD with a source-specific original c64 write.
R84 R30 tests GetLastRawGameWvpWrite and GetLastGameWvpSemanticProvenance against the current shader, pose, direct-versus-queue scope, active node and epoch before native GPU submission.

R30 derives stereo-eye HUD WVP only when direct c64 has no live SpriteNode or queued HUD matches the same node/epoch; R33 preserves original one-draw mono fallback and eye publication on unsafe source.
subcomponents: Reject a lingering live queue node from both current direct physical draw and written direct c64 provenance, while respecting the historical epoch that remains nonzero after queue leave.
Compile positive direct and same-node queued source cases plus cross-node, inconsistent direct state and stale queued-epoch negatives as C++ static contract regressions at the actual R84 header.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: OutRun native direct HUD c64 through R84 R30 stereo-eye acceptance
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Original direct HUD c64 remains eligible only with no live node on either source or draw; historical nonzero queue epochs alone do not reject a valid direct source.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Queued source identity and original mono fallback after foreign reentrant SpriteNode
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Valid same-node same-epoch queued HUD remains eligible, while foreign nodes, stale epochs and mismatched direct owners reject stereo promotion without changing original Draw output.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Windows R84 native game and OpenXR host plus DX9Ex Active, Domain, HUD and Full Source Impact actions
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: The integrated source-and-contract SHA passes all triggered mandatory GitHub Actions jobs; Quest3 HMD visual acceptance remains untested.

diagnosis.root_cause: OwnsProducer on the direct ScreenHud raw WVP path checked only writtenNode for null and ignored a selected currentNode. A reentrant or just-finished queue cursor could be misinterpreted as original direct HUD c64 despite a stale physical queue selection.
source_trace: src/vr/game/render_semantics.hpp current queue cursor and effective HUD semantic producer
src/vr/d3d9/stereo_renderer_r30.cpp original WVP provenance and exact shader HUD eye routing
alternatives_rejected: Do not enlarge shader/pose draw-age windows, infer HUD from alpha/FVF, or consume/suppress the native OutRun glyph; these alternatives would risk road, lens or stage producer confusion.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Material C++ source commit e32f2fd18cfbcf871732acb8d48383ae8926cb28 rejects currentNode for direct original ScreenHud and preserves valid historic queue epochs.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: C++ compile-time constexpr positive direct and queued tests with negative current-node, written-node, foreign node and node-epoch mutations; Windows exact-SHA integrated gate pending.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Both XR HUD eye matrices may consume one original direct ScreenHud c64 only when source and current physical draw are provably direct; unsafe requests keep one original mono GPU submission.
diagnosis.evidence_limit: Deterministic semantic admission bug is source-confirmed. No matching Quest3 optical failure or visual correction is claimed; RUNTIME_VALIDATION=UNTESTED.
